::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 2. 1865  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS. 55384 (2): P. 885
:::

Dear Miss Yonge	
[I](people/person_939.qmd) am home again and at work, having greatly enjoyed my holiday.

I hope to see you soon in London. Will you kindly give us notice when you are coming. I am anxious to see what can be done, if anything in the way of a [vignette](organizations/other_167.qmd) for the “[Dove](cmy_books/cmybook_62.qmd)”.

Yours ever truly
A. Macmillan

Many thanks for the information you kindly sent [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)
